projects.name: Polaris Forge 1
projects.quote: CoreWeave holds 400 MW under contract at Polaris Forge 1, representing approximately $11 billion of prospective lease revenue over the term of its leases, while a U.S. based investment-grade hyperscaler holds 200 MW at Polaris Forge 2, representing approximately $5 billion of prospective lease revenue over the term of its lease.

projects.name: ELN-02, Polaris Forge 1
projects.quote: During the quarter, Polaris Forge 1 reached Ready-for-Service, delivering 100 MW on schedule and fully energizing the first building (ELN-02).

projects.name: ELN-03, Polaris Forge 1
projects.quote: A second 150 MW HPC data center is under construction at the same campus and is expected to come online in calendar 2026, while a third 150 MW facility is anticipated in calendar 2027.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 2
projects.quote: On August 18, 2025, we broke ground on Polaris Forge 2, a $3 billion, 200 MW data center campus near Harwood, North Dakota.

projects.name: Jamestown, ND data center
projects.quote: As of November 30, 2025, the Company’s 106 MW facility in Jamestown, ND, and 180 MW facility in Ellendale, ND, are operating at full capacity.
